## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- Claims 1–3 are accurately grounded, and the bounded source inspection correctly finds no signed rectangular equality in the cited passages.
- Claim 4’s mathematical equality remains unproved and undisproved. The draft supplies neither explicit \(F_{\rho,\sigma}\) nor a map from the accepted full-coordinate \(\operatorname{Lin}_\varphi\)-row identity to the asserted relation in \(A_+J_v\). The graded-kernel presentation alone cannot determine these transition coordinates.
- The boundary conventions are stated, but they do not repair the missing universal derivation. The finite \((2,3,2,2)\) evidence cannot establish all admissible cases.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Define the rectangle-attachment map and derive term-by-term from the accepted full-coordinate Hopf row identity
  \[
  \bar s_{L_\rho}-(-1)^{|\rho|}\bar s_{R_\rho}\in A_+J_v
  \]
  for every \(\rho\subseteq b^a\), proving the two endpoint coefficients and that every remaining term has a strictly lower attachment; alternatively, give an admissible counterexample disproving the equation.
